secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxx.supabase.co). Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL. Optional — app boots without it; only the Decor catalog page needs it.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key. Found in Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public. Optional — app boots without it; only the Decor catalog page needs it.
